'''Ketwol'''<ref name="Card Trader">{{SWCT|set=Alien Underground|cardname=Ketwol}}</ref> was a [[Pacithhip]] who met with the [[Devaronian]]<ref name="CL" /> [[Kardue'sai'Malloc]]<ref name="Labria">{{ForceCollection|Kardue'sai'Malloc|star=2}}</ref> and the aged [[Defel]]<ref name="CL" /> [[Arleil Schous]]<ref name="AEYNTK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> over a jigger of [[Merenzane Gold]] in a booth at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]<ref name="CL" /> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref>

The [[Lamproid]]<ref name="A New Hope" /> [[Dice Ibegon]]<ref name="Force Collection">''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' {{C|Card: Dice Ibegon (★)}}</ref> also sat with the trio at the table, and Ketwol spoke to<ref name="A New Hope" /> her<ref name="Force Collection" /> in [[Shimiese]] while she spoke [[Lamproid (language)|Lamproid]]<ref name="Language">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Language in Star Wars Movies|video=CZp8Civk2co|nolive=1}}</ref> shortly before<ref name="A New Hope" /> the local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] was thrown in to the table next to the group during an altercation with the criminals [[Ponda Baba]] and [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]].<ref name="CL" /> Ketwol had mottled [[Color|gray]] skin and blue [[eye]]s. The Pacithhip wore a red [[robe]] over a tan [[Clothing|shirt]] while at the [[cantina]].<ref name="A New Hope" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Special edition addition===
{{Quote|I received artwork from Skywalker Ranch and started sculpting the head and shoulders out of water based clay the same day. It was a very fast project, with the final rubber and foam puppet being complete in just over a week. At the time, I was pretty much on my own doing this project.|Howie Weed|<ref name="Howie Weed">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsinterviews1|url=2010/05/howie-weed-interview-creature-maker.html|name=Star Wars Interviews|text=Howie Weed interview|date=2010-05|quote=I received artwork from Skywalker Ranch and started sculpting the head and shoulders out of water based clay the same day. It was a very fast project, with the final rubber and foam puppet being complete in just over a week. At the time, I was pretty much on my own doing this project.}}</ref>}}
Ketwol first appeared in the [[1997]] ''[[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]]'' re-release of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. Full body concept sketches for the character were created by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] on [[December 13]], [[1995]],<ref name="Archive">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref> who gave the [[alien]] a large rounded body with tiny legs since they were only going to be seen from the shoulders up.<ref name="Ketwol DB">{{DB|character|ketwol|Ketwol}}</ref>

[[File:KetwolPuppet.png|thumb|right|300px|Ketwol was a highly detailed rubber and foam puppet created by Howie Weed for the ''Special Edition'' re-release of ''A New Hope''.]]
The sketches were sent to the creature shop at [[Industrial Light & Magic]] in [[Wikipedia:San Rafael, California|San Rafael]] and were one of the first hints that [[Howie Weed]] and others there got as to the scope of director [[George Lucas]]'s plans for the changes being made in the re-release.<ref name="Insider211">{{InsiderCite|211|"See It Again… For the First Time!": The Saga of the Special Editions}}</ref> Weed, who was lead creature designer for the ''Special Edition'', began sculpting the head and shoulders for Ketwol out of water based clay the same day he received the sketch, which was the first to have been approved. Working mostly alone at this early point in the ''Special Edition'' development, Weed completed the project quickly in just over a week and produced a rubber and foam puppet.<ref name="Howie Weed" />

Once the puppet was finished, several takes of it were shot on the main stage at San Rafael over a couple of hours. During filming, [[John Knoll]] noticed that the back of Ketwol's head looked like another alien and suggested they flip it around and film the other side as well. Wardrobe supervisor [[Anne Polland]] then pulled together a new Tatooine-appropriate outfit that included a turban to hide Ketwol's trunk and tusks while [[Mark Siegel]] created a makeshift hookah pipe with a tube that allowed smoke to be blown through. They then shot footage of this new alien, which would later become known as [[Melas]] the [[Sarkan]].<ref name="Insider211" /> The footage of the highly detailed Ketwol puppet was then digitally inserted into a shot from the cantina scene, replacing the character [[Lak Sivrak]],<ref name="Ketwol DB" /> whose off-the-shelf mask had long bothered Lucas.<ref name="CantinaRollCall">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> The original audio intended to be Sivrak growling was left unchanged in the scene.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>

===Identification===
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Ketwol was first identified on a digital card released on the [[Star Wars: Card Trader|''Star Wars'': Card Trader]] app in [[2017]].<ref name="Card Trader" /> The [[Ketwol/Legends|character's]] name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in the ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a [[1997]] supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]].<ref name="SE Sourcebook">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>
